passages.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
passages.sermon:
The LORD reigns.
He is King over all.
The earth rejoices.
Many distant shores are glad.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ תָּגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִ֝שְׂמְח֗וּ אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
passages.sermon:
The LORD reigns over all the earth.
Clouds surround Him.
Darkness surrounds Him.
Righteousness forms the foundation of His throne.
Justice forms the foundation of His throne.
passages.original: עָנָ֣ן וַעֲרָפֶ֣ל סְבִיבָ֑יו צֶ֥דֶק וּ֝מִשְׁפָּ֗ט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
passages.sermon: The LORD is King over all the earth.\r\nFire goes in front of Him.\r\nThis fire destroys His enemies all around Him.
passages.original: אֵ֭שׁ לְפָנָ֣יו תֵּלֵ֑ךְ וּתְלַהֵ֖ט סָבִ֣יב צָרָֽיו׃

passages.text: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
passages.sermon:
God sends out lightning.
His lightning shines and lights up the world.
The earth sees the lightning.
The earth trembles.
passages.original: הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקָ֣יו תֵּבֵ֑ל רָאֲתָ֖ה וַתָּחֵ֣ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is present.
The LORD is the Lord of all the earth.
Mountains stand before Him.
Mountains melt like wax in His presence.
passages.original: הָרִ֗ים כַּדּוֹנַ֗ג נָ֭מַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֲד֣וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
passages.sermon: God rules over all the earth.\r\nThe heavens show that God is righteous.\r\nAll people see God's glory.
passages.original: הִגִּ֣ידוּ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם צִדְק֑וֹ וְרָא֖וּ כָל־ הָעַמִּ֣ים כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord of all the earth.
He is above every other god.
People who worship images feel shame.
People who boast in idols feel shame.
All gods must worship the Lord.
passages.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ׀ כָּל־ עֹ֬בְדֵי פֶ֗סֶל הַמִּֽתְהַלְלִ֥ים בָּאֱלִילִ֑ים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֝וֹ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
passages.sermon:
Zion is a holy city.
Zion hears about God's judgments.
Zion rejoices.
The towns of Judah hear about God's judgments.
The towns of Judah exult.
God, You give judgments.
Your judgments cause Zion and Judah to rejoice.
passages.original: שָׁמְעָ֬ה וַתִּשְׂמַ֨ח׀ צִיּ֗וֹן וַ֭תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֑ה לְמַ֖עַן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֣יךָ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is Most High.
He rules over all the earth.
He stands far above every other god.
No one is greater than the LORD.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה עֶלְי֥וֹן עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד נַ֝עֲלֵ֗יתָ עַל־ כָּל־ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
passages.sermon: Those who love the LORD must hate evil.\r\nThe LORD preserves the lives of His faithful people.\r\nHe rescues them from the power of the wicked.
passages.original: אֹהֲבֵ֥י יְהוָ֗ה שִׂנְא֫וּ רָ֥ע שֹׁ֭מֵר נַפְשׁ֣וֹת חֲסִידָ֑יו מִיַּ֥ד רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽם׃

passages.text: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
passages.sermon: God gives light to the righteous.\r\nGod gives gladness to those who are upright in heart.
passages.original: א֭וֹר זָרֻ֣עַ לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּֽלְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵ֥ב שִׂמְחָֽה׃

passages.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
He is worthy of praise.
You who are righteous, rejoice in the LORD.
Praise His holy name.
passages.original: שִׂמְח֣וּ צַ֭דִּיקִים בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְ֝הוֹד֗וּ לְזֵ֣כֶר קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃
